1: Heat produced per second when repairing the hull.
2: Additional heat produced per second when repairing the hull after the repair delay period.
3: Modifies the heat produced when repairing the hull by the given factor.
4: Modifies the ship's total hull strength by the given factor.
5: Amount of hull strength that can be repaired per second. Repairs usually consume energy and may generate heat as well.
6: Additional hull strength that can be repaired per second after the repair delay period.
7: The number of seconds it takes for additional hull repairs to begin after taking hull damage.
8: The number of seconds it takes for hull repairs to begin after being disabled.
9: The number of seconds it takes for a disabled ship to repair itself.
10: The energy cost required for a disabled ship to repair itself.
11: The fuel cost required for a disabled ship to repair itself.
12: The heat applied when a disabled ship repairs itself.
13: The ion damage applied when a disabled ship repairs itself.
14: The scrambling damage applied when a disabled ship repairs itself.
15: The disruption damage applied when a disabled ship repairs itself.
16: The slowing damage applied when a disabled ship repairs itself.
17: The discharge damage applied when a disabled ship repairs itself.
18: The corrosion damage applied when a disabled ship repairs itself.
19: The leak damage applied when a disabled ship repairs itself.
20: The burning damage applied when a disabled ship repairs itself.
21: The remaining hull strength at which the ship becomes disabled. This attribute takes priority over other attributes that change the disabled threshold.
22: Modifies the hull strength value at which the ship will become disabled.
23: Modifies the percentage of the remaining hull strength at which the ship will become disabled.
24: Protection provided against direct hull damage. Increases by the given factor how much hull damage a ship can withstand before it loses as much hull as an unprotected ship.
25: Modifies the amount of hull strength repaired per second by the given factor.
26: Modifies the amount of hull strength repaired per second by the given factor while a cloaking device is active.
27: Amount of credits you can be fined for carrying this outfit.
28: Amount of credits received per day when you own this outfit, even if it is not in active use.
29: Reduces effective ship mass. Increases how quickly a ship accelerates by the given factor.
30: Protection provided against ion damage. Modifies by the given factor how much ion damage a ship can withstand before it loses as much energy as an unprotected ship.
